verdict.rationale: Abacum documents budgets alongside live actuals, drill-down to source data, and investor-report narratives that update when actuals flow in. None of the evidence says the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance, such as naming its drivers or causes. Drill-down and auto-updating report narratives are adjacent features, not documented variance explanation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance rather than only flagging it
